name: academic-cv-editor
description: Review, rewrite, tailor, and render credible research-oriented academic CVs in English by default.

interface.shortDescription: Review and create credible academic CVs in English.
interface.longDescription: Review, rewrite, tailor, and render academic CVs for research opportunities, PhD applications, scholarships, and conferences. Preserve factual status and academic nuance; use the included LaTeX template when requested.
defaultPrompt: Review my academic CV for a PhD application and flag factual or status issues.
Rewrite my research CV in English without inventing achievements.
Tailor my CV for this research assistant role and render it with the included LaTeX template.
